# Explanation

Explanation pages describe how RECAP works and why its design matters. They
cover namespaces, provenance, lifecycle and freezing, local/remote transport,
authentication, authorization, and command processing.

For exact signatures, accepted values, return models, and failure behavior, see
the [Reference](/reference/index.html) section. Explanation describes why
RECAP behaves as it does; Reference is lookup material rather than workflow
instruction.
